BARROW STATEMENT ON AIG BONUSES

Washington, DC - Congressman John Barrow (GA-12)
released the following statement today:


"The more we learn about failed executives of companies like
AIG making off with taxpayer money that's supposed to save their companies the
angrier I get.  This is exactly why I
didn't vote for the bailout last fall, and why I think the only money we should
be spending should go to keeping families in their homes and putting businesses
back to work.  We need to crack down on
greedy execs who line their pockets with taxpayer money."
